description: Options controlling how an IImportFileParser reads an import source. Positional parameters carry sensible defaults so new ImportParseOptions() works out of the box.

members.name: HasHeaderRow
members.description: When true (default) the first record supplies the column names and is not returned as a data row; when false, columns are named positionally and every record is treated as data.

members.name: Delimiter
members.description: Field delimiter for delimited formats such as CSV. Defaults to a comma.
